places.name: Powder River
places.note: The herd trails up its valley; the hands dislike its water and blame it for cramps. Call later leaves the valley once drought seems past.

places.name: Bighorn Mountains
places.note: Snow-capped range seen to the west after crossing the Powder; the wounded grizzly flees toward these hills.
places.location_hint: west of the herd's route along the Powder River

places.name: Crazy Woman Creek
places.note: Crossed soon after leaving the Powder; along a branch of it a grizzly scatters the outfit and fights the Texas bull to a draw.
places.location_hint: tributary of the Powder River, east of the Bighorn Mountains; the bear fight is on a small stream branching off it

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Hands regret not buying warmer coats there when they had the chance.

places.name: Tennessee
places.note: Call asks why Augustus left his well-off family there; Augustus says it was too tame.

places.name: Texas
places.note: The hands are south Texas cowboys unused to snow; spooked horses act as if fleeing back there.

places.name: Red River
places.note: Augustus jokes the panicked outfit might run all the way back to it.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Call doubts the mauled bull can walk all the way there.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: trailing northwest beyond Crazy Woman Creek, east of the snowy Bighorn Mountains, about a week after the bear fight
